mkdir -p "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp"
python3 scripts/parse-acs.py --issue 1164 > "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/acs-1164.md"

python3 scripts/workpad.py new-body 1164 --no-reproduction --branch issue-1164-init-rename-sweep > "$BODY"
python3 scripts/workpad.py create 1164 "$BODY"

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; ls .changeset/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---sample---"; for f in .changeset/*.md; do [ "$f" = ".changeset/issue-1164-init-rename-sweep.md" ] && continue; echo "== $f =="; head -8 "$f"; break; done; echo "---consolidator frontmatter handling---"; grep -n "type\|bump" scripts/consolidate-changesets.py | head -20
